name: Miharu Sena Kanaka
source: An alien girl who comes from another world called Seiren. Sweet, kind, yet full of curiosity. She appeared out of Sasaki's bathtub and she ends up being transported to Earth. Since then, she stayed on Earth at Sasaki's house yearning to explore the curious Earth.
